title: Naturality of the specified common-field tensor component
statement:
theorem completedTensorCommonComponent_naturality
    (symmetry : @SymmetricCategory _ _ closed.monoidal)
    (N : ∀ E, CompletedTensorFiniteModel l X R closed models E)
    (coherence : RingedDerivedTensorCoherence.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R) closed models symmetry)
    {P Q : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) X ×
      generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) X}
    (f : P ⟶ Q) :
    (((ordinary l X R).prod (ordinary l X R)) ⋙ closed.tensor).map f ≫
        (completedTensorCommonComponent l X R closed models N Q.1 Q.2).hom =
      (completedTensorCommonComponent l X R closed models N P.1 P.2).hom ≫
        (commonStageDerivedTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) X ⋙ ordinary l X R).map f

source.place: BS Definition 3.4.10 and Remark 6.8.15; HRS Proposition 5.2 and Lemma 7.9; the corresponding part of the finite normalized realization argument.

proof.text: Represent both coordinates of the input arrow over finite fields, then enlarge to a single common upper field. The two exists_mkHom_eq equations and mkHom_eq_isoToStage express the original product arrow as the included rational pair conjugated by endpoint isoToStage isomorphisms.

Apply completedTensorCommonComponent_stage_transport at the source pair and target pair. These two equations identify the components with the finite-stage components conjugated by those very endpoint isomorphisms.

Apply completedTensorStageComponent_naturality to the represented rational pair at the common finite field. Functoriality and cancellation of inverse endpoint isomorphisms conjugate this finite square into the required square. The private conjugated_square lemma verifies this cancellation in an arbitrary category.
